action.objective: Retreat the queen to h3, keeping it active on the h3-c8 diagonal and out of exchanges on f5.
action.rationale: f5h3 is the only commit_ready move. Verification at full depth 4 returned exact score 113 with PV f5h3 e5g4 d5f4; safety.complete is true with no mating reply and no forced mate. It also topped the broad depth-2 search with the same 114 exact score, while every other candidate scored below zero with an upper bound (potentially much worse).
